title: Chip Industry Week In Review
summary: 本周综述披露多项半导体动态：Marvell拟全股票收购Lumentum，交易待股东和监管批准；SK hynix与三星称HBM/DRAM供应紧张，部分年份已售罄；台积电据报考虑上调CoWoS价格。部分消息为媒体报道或尚待核实。
reason: 材料为行业周度综述，含具体公司、产品、产能和资本动作，投资相关性强；但属多事件汇编，且部分为据报道或未确认，证据强度与行动指向分散。；存在待复核项
articleBody:
Updated 11/2 for Marvell’s planned acquisition of Lumentum.

Deals and funding

Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction with an implied enterprise value of $115B, combining Marvell’s custom silicon, networking and interconnect technologies with Lumentum’s lasers, optical transceivers and optical circuit switching. The proposed combination would expand the companies’ capabilities in AI data center connectivity, silicon photonics and advanced packaging. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2028, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

Intel plans to acquire Classiq, a developer of automated quantum algorithm synthesis software. Intel says the acquisition will give it a full stack of quantum offerings, adding to its silicon spin-qubit technology and manufacturing.

Unconventional AI plans to acquire NeuReality.

Unconfirmed:  Onsemi reportedly is in talks to acquire Ferric, a startup developing integrated voltage regulators for AI processors, for nearly $1B, according to The Information.

FuriosaAI raised $620M to scale production of its AI inference accelerator.

AI memory and capacity

SK hynix expects memory supply constraints to persist through 2030, with DRAM and HBM volumes effectively sold out through 2029. Samsung expects tight memory supply through 2028, citing lengthy fab construction and equipment lead times, larger dies, and greater process complexity in next-gen HBM, as well as a shift of DRAM capacity toward HBM. Samsung said its 2027 HBM supply is already sold out.

Solidigm, SK hynix’s U.S. subsidiary, reportedly is discussing a proposed $45B NAND flash fab with the U.S. Commerce Department.

China’s CXMT plans to soon begin limited production of HBM3E memory, despite manufacturing yields of just 20% to 30%, per Reuters.

Anthropic warned in its IPO filing that HBM shortages and limited TSMC manufacturing capacity could constrain AI expansion.

Advanced packaging

ASE forecasts a doubling of its advanced-packaging revenue in 2027, and Amkor is ramping new high-density fan-out and 2.5D packaging programs.

TSMC reportedly is considering a 20% price increase for CoWoS as AI demand continues to strain advanced-packaging capacity.

Applied Materials plans to increase its stake in Besi to ~20%, deepening a strategic partnership that is expanding beyond hybrid bonding into new interconnect architectures and advanced packaging technologies for AI.

Manufacturing

Intel Foundry reported improving manufacturing execution in Q3, citing better yields and cycle times on 18A. The company also released its 14A 0.9 PDK in October and said it continues to engage prospective external customers around 18A-P and 14A, while advancing its EMIB-T advanced-packaging technology.

Infineon plans to invest €1.1B through 2034 at its Villach, Austria facility to establish Europe’s first high-volume manufacturing facility for next-gen GaN power semiconductors on 300mm wafers.

UMC approved an additional $3.2B in capital spending to accelerate its capacity expansion in Singapore and Tainan as demand grows for advanced packaging and silicon photonics.

Lam Research and imec expanded their collaboration on advanced 3D integration, next-gen memory, and high-NA EUV patterning. The work includes deposition, etch, and plasma dicing processes for advanced packaging, along with Lam’s Aether dry resist technology.

AI tools and accelerators

Cadence introduced a portfolio of domain-specialized AI models for agentic chip and system design. Integrated with Cadence’s EDA tools, the portfolio spans multiple model sizes and architectures, combining post-trained LLMs, decision models, and self-improving agent skills.

Arm introduced a new CPU benchmarking methodology for agentic AI. The framework evaluates CPU performance across agentic workloads, including tool execution, orchestration, and reasoning, using repeatable measurements and end-to-end task outcomes.

Google is expanding the reach of its custom AI accelerators, with OpenAI reportedly planning to purchase its TPUs, reports The Information. Separately, Oracle will offer Google’s TPUs through its cloud infrastructure beginning in 2027 and plans to add Arm’s AGI CPUs in fall 2027.

Broadcom‘s XPUs and networking equipment will support Anthropic‘s AI infrastructure expansion, beginning in 2027, under a $63B financing arrangement.

Meta is expanding deployments of Nvidia and AMD AI infrastructure across its data centers, with both chipmakers also taking stakes in the company.

Earnings

Quarterly revenue and % growth versus the same quarter in the prior year, unless otherwise indicated:

Advantest: ¥477.7B, up 82%, with robust tester demand for AI.

Amkor: Net income $191M, up 50%, due to a richer mix of high-value advanced packaging.

ASE: NT$244.2B, up 45%.

Cadence: $1.6B, up 22%, with a record backlog of $8.2B.

Intel: $16.5B, up 21%, with data center and AI sales up 78% and foundry revenue up 58%.

Rambus: Record $218M, up 22%.

Samsung: KRW 195.3T, up 127%, major ramp in HBM4.

SK hynix: Record KRW 104.6T, up 328%.

Teradyne: $1.3B, up 70%, with record memory and systems test revenue.

UMC: NT$74.2B, up ~25.6%, with fab utilization reaching 92%.

Global

Asia

Vietnam‘s first semiconductor fab may miss its 2027 trial-production target, according to Reuters. The estimated US$1.3B Viettel project reportedly has yet to begin construction, while negotiations for ASML lithography equipment remain unresolved. Viettel maintains the project is on schedule.

South Korea’s PSK is planning a new US$125M semiconductor equipment manufacturing facility in Yongin’s semiconductor cluster.

Americas

ITIF says the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative has grown to 26 countries, coordinating on semiconductors, critical minerals, energy, advanced manufacturing, and AI infrastructure to reduce dependence on vulnerable supply chains.

Imec and Indiana University formed a semiconductor research partnership focused on advanced electronics, photonics, and workforce development. Initial research will test imec-developed electronic and photonic components in extreme environments, including space.

Cadence will provide U.S. Department of Energy National Laboratories with access to EDA, SDA, multiphysics simulation, digital twins, advanced packaging, and 3D-IC workflows, along with technical expertise.

Europe

SUSS MicroTec will consolidate semiconductor equipment production in Zhubei, Taiwan, and Sternenfels, Germany, and end manufacturing at its Garching facility near Munich.

New Technologies

Chip design and verification

ChipAgents is expanding its agentic AI platform across digital and analog chip design with a neural engine that combines persistent design knowledge, advanced reasoning and orchestration, dynamic model routing, and physics-aware models. It will also work with Nvidia to fine-tune Nemotron models.

Axiomise and Agnisys teamed up to verify NoCs using formal technologies.

AI power delivery

Infineon introduced new AI power-delivery technologies, including a ±400 V/800 V rack power-distribution reference board, a 5.6 kW M-CRPS reference design, and 900 V monolithic bidirectional GaN switches for solid-state transformers in AI data centers.

Compute, memory and photonics

PsiQuantum demonstrated an 8×8 optical circuit switch built on silicon photonics for AI infrastructure.

TetraMem taped out a 12nm analog in-memory computing SoC based on multi-level RRAM and developed using Synopsys‘ cloud EDA tools.

Fraunhofer IIS integrated permanent micromagnets directly into the silicon substrate of a magnetic sensor chip at wafer level.

Automotive

Infineon introduced a chip-embedding platform for high-voltage power electronics, LinearFET technology for solid-state power distribution in EVs and SDVs, new MOSFETs for 12 V and 48 V vehicle systems, and a high-voltage BMS reference design.

STMicro released an automotive safety sensor platform that combines accelerometers and gyroscopes for ADAS and vehicle-safety applications.

Bosch debuted a new MEMS inertial sensor platform, combining ADAS and vehicle-safety functions up to ASIL D.

Research

TU Munich researchers developed neural-network-based transistor models for 3nm nanosheet devices, accelerating standard-cell library characterization by up to 8× compared with a conventional compact model. The models kept delay-estimation errors below 0.11%.

A Brown University-led team demonstrated ultrathin multiferroic films that retain ferroelectric and magnetic properties at thicknesses of just a few angstroms, overcoming the dead-layer effect in bismuth ferrite. The films also exhibited altermagnetic properties, potentially enabling low-power memory and logic devices.

Chinese Academy of Sciences-led researchers developed a III-nitride-based in-sensor computing device that uses interfacial polarization to separate photogenerated carriers and reduce recombination losses. The sensor-memristor achieved responsivity on the order of 10⁶ A/W, an on/off ratio of 10⁵, and maintained high performance at temperatures up to 300°C.

University of Oxford-led researchers identified a pseudo-direct semiconductor in bismuth sulfide that combines strong light absorption with slower electron–hole recombination. Its unusual electronic structure was estimated to reduce recombination rates by about 75% at room temperature compared with conventional semiconductors with similarly strong absorption, potentially improving solar-cell efficiency.

Security

MITRE’s CWE Program released CWE 5.0, adding new weaknesses, including Hardware Simulation/Synthesis Mismatch. The new hardware weakness covers security-relevant cases where RTL behaves differently after synthesis, potentially exposing data, altering protected state, or bypassing security controls in the resulting hardware.

Alerts and hacks

TianoCore disclosed a critical vulnerability in its widely used EDK II UEFI firmware. The memory-corruption flaw could allow an unauthenticated network attacker to execute code during PXE boot, before the OS loads and before Secure Boot or measured boot can verify any OS component.

Supermicro disclosed nine BMC firmware vulnerabilities across two Oct. 26 advisories, including a critical flaw that could let an unauthenticated network attacker execute arbitrary IPMI commands on an active session. The disclosures also cover privilege-escalation, key-exposure, memory-access, and command-injection flaws.

Keystone said a breach exposed a key used to authenticate its hardware wallets, potentially allowing counterfeit devices to pass authenticity checks. The company is destroying 18,835 unsold devices containing the compromised key.

Government security news

NIST finalized its road map for transitioning to PQC, identifying the quantum-vulnerable standards that federal systems and technology providers will need to replace with quantum-resistant algorithms.

NIST also explained its RF-fingerprinting technique for detecting hardware tampering, using subtle differences in devices’ radio emissions to identify altered or substituted components with more than 95% accuracy in testing.

New capabilities and tools

Eclypsium and Nvidia demonstrated how a compromised privileged component in AI compute infrastructure could alter model weights and outputs during live inference without modifying the stored model.

Altera introduced its Agilex 2X FPGA and SoC portfolio with a hardware root of trust, secure boot and attestation, PQC-ready crypto, and line-rate encryption for Ethernet, PCIe and memory.

Google introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model with cybersecurity capabilities.

Security technical papers

Fault Vulnerability of HW Malware Detectors (UC Davis et al)

Detection & classification of RISC-V HW exploits using ML (UPC)

Bringing Hardware Security Education to All (U. of Kansas, UF et al.)

Provably Secure Data Memory-Dependent Prefetching (DistriNet, KU Leuven)

Rowhammer attack on Fil-C’s software capabilities (Independent researcher and U. Sussex)

Trending Video

Why Proof Convergence Matters: Leveraging patterns in formal verification to reach sign-off faster. Ashish Darbari, CEO of Axiomise, talks about the impact of functional interactions involving safety and security, where to look for common patterns to prevent bugs from creeping into these designs, and how this all can be used to reduce time to sign-off with higher coverage.

Quantum Hardware

IBM demonstrated four interconnects linking two Nighthawk quantum processors, achieving 99% average quantum state-transfer fidelity and 94.75% two-qubit gate fidelity, advancing modular quantum computing.

NVision Quantum demonstrated a single-molecule spin-photon interface and partnered with HyperLight to integrate molecular qubits onto photonic chips using established semiconductor fabrication processes.

FZ Jülich-led researchers demonstrated 6.8-nanosecond single-qubit gates on a superconducting transmon, achieving 99.981% and 99.989% fidelity. Precision pulse shaping suppressed unwanted transitions, keeping leakage below 0.002% per operation.

A Technical University of Denmark team demonstrated integrated quantum light sources using 2D materials, coupling WSe₂ single-photon emitters to WS₂ waveguides on a chip, with an estimated minimum waveguide-coupled rate of 1.68 million photons per second.

Workforce, Education

In a new special report, Semiconductor Engineering examines how AI is changing the skills tomorrow’s engineers will need, with universities placing greater emphasis on strong math and physics fundamentals, critical thinking, and the ability to validate AI-generated results. Semiconductor employers say graduates will need both AI fluency and enough technical depth to recognize when AI gets things wrong.

Northeastern University developed a VR and holographic training platform for semiconductor manufacturing that lets one student operate a simulated nanofabrication furnace used to grow nanowires while other students follow the process on a 3D display.

UCSD and TSMC launched a new hands-on semiconductor training program for undergraduates.

交易与融资

items: Marvell 同意以全股票交易收购 Lumentum，隐含企业价值为 $115B，将 Marvell 的定制芯片、网络与互连技术与 Lumentum 的激光器、光收发器和光电路交换相结合。拟议合并将扩展两家公司在 AI 数据中心连接、硅光子和先进封装方面的能力。该交易预计于 2028 年上半年完成，尚需股东和监管批准。
Intel 计划收购 Classiq，后者是一家开发自动化量子算法合成软件的公司。Intel 称，此次收购将为其带来完整的量子产品栈，并补充其硅自旋量子比特技术和制造能力。
Unconventional AI 计划收购 NeuReality。
未经证实：据 The Information 报道，Onsemi 据称正洽谈以近 $1B 收购 Ferric，后者是一家为 AI 处理器开发集成稳压器的初创公司。
FuriosaAI 融资 $620M，以扩大其 AI 推理加速器的生产规模。

blocks.text: AI 存储器与产能

items: SK hynix 预计存储器供应紧张将持续到 2030 年，其中 DRAM 和 HBM 的供应量到 2029 年实际上已售罄。Samsung 预计存储器供应紧张将持续到 2028 年，理由包括晶圆厂建设周期和设备交付周期漫长、芯片面积更大、下一代 HBM 工艺复杂度更高，以及 DRAM 产能向 HBM 转移。Samsung 称其 2027 年 HBM 供应已经售罄。
据报道，SK hynix 的美国子公司 Solidigm 正与美国商务部讨论一项拟议的 $45B NAND 闪存晶圆厂项目。
据 Reuters 报道，中国 CXMT 计划很快开始 HBM3E 存储器的有限量产，尽管制造良率仅为 20% 至 30%。
Anthropic 在其 IPO 文件中警告称，HBM 短缺和 TSMC 制造产能有限可能制约 AI 扩张。

blocks.text: 先进封装

items: ASE 预计其先进封装收入将在 2027 年翻倍，Amkor 正在推进新的高密度扇出和 2.5D 封装项目上量。
据报道，随着 AI 需求持续挤压先进封装产能，TSMC 正考虑将 CoWoS 价格上调 20%。
Applied Materials 计划将其在 Besi 的持股比例增至约 20%，深化战略合作伙伴关系，该合作正从混合键合扩展到面向 AI 的新互连架构和先进封装技术。

blocks.text: 制造

items: Intel Foundry 报告称第三季度制造执行情况改善，理由是 18A 的良率和周期时间有所改善。该公司还在 10 月发布了 14A 0.9 PDK，并表示继续围绕 18A-P 和 14A 与潜在外部客户接洽，同时推进其 EMIB-T 先进封装技术。
Infineon 计划到 2034 年在其奥地利 Villach 工厂投资 €1.1B，建设欧洲首个基于 300mm 晶圆的下一代 GaN 功率半导体大规模制造工厂。
UMC 批准额外 $3.2B 资本支出，以加快在新加坡和台南的产能扩张，满足先进封装和硅光子日益增长的需求。
Lam Research 与 imec 扩大了在先进 3D 集成、下一代存储器和 High-NA EUV 图形化方面的合作。该工作包括面向先进封装的沉积、刻蚀和等离子切割工艺，以及 Lam 的 Aether 干法光刻胶技术。

blocks.text: AI 工具与加速器

items: Cadence 推出了一套面向智能体芯片与系统设计的领域专用 AI 模型产品组合。该产品组合与 Cadence 的 EDA 工具集成，覆盖多种模型规模和架构，融合了后训练 LLM、决策模型和可自我改进的智能体技能。
Arm 推出面向智能体 AI 的新 CPU 基准测试方法。该框架使用可重复的测量和端到端任务结果，评估 CPU 在智能体工作负载中的性能，包括工具执行、编排和推理。
据The Information报道，Google正在扩大其定制AI加速器的覆盖范围，OpenAI据报计划购买其TPU。另外，Oracle将从2027年开始通过其云基础设施提供Google的TPU，并计划在2027年秋季增加Arm的AGI CPU。
根据一项$63B的融资安排，Broadcom的XPU和网络设备将从2027年开始支持Anthropic的AI基础设施扩张。
Meta正在其数据中心扩大Nvidia和AMD AI基础设施的部署，这两家芯片制造商也都将入股该公司。

STMicro 发布了一款汽车安全传感器平台，结合加速度计和陀螺仪，面向 ADAS 和车辆安全应用。
Bosch 首次推出新的 MEMS 惯性传感器平台，融合 ADAS 和车辆安全功能，最高达到 ASIL D。

blocks.text: 研究
TU Munich 研究人员为 3nm 纳米片器件开发了基于神经网络的晶体管模型，与传统紧凑模型相比，将标准单元库表征加速最高 8 倍。这些模型将延迟估计误差保持在 0.11% 以下。
由 Brown University 领导的团队展示了超薄多铁薄膜，在仅几个埃的厚度下仍保持铁电和磁性，克服了铁酸铋中的死层效应。这些薄膜还表现出交错磁（altermagnetic）特性，有望实现低功耗存储和逻辑器件。
由 Chinese Academy of Sciences 领导的研究人员开发了一种基于 III 族氮化物的感内计算器件，利用界面极化分离光生载流子并降低复合损耗。该传感器-忆阻器实现了约 10⁶ A/W 的响应度、10⁵ 的开关比，并在高达 300°C 的温度下保持高性能。
由 University of Oxford 领导的研究人员在硫化铋中发现了一种赝直接半导体，兼具强光吸收和较慢的电子-空穴复合。据估计，其独特电子结构在室温下可将复合率较具有相似强吸收的传统半导体降低约 75%，有望提高太阳能电池效率。
安全
MITRE 的 CWE Program 发布了 CWE 5.0，新增了新的弱点，包括硬件仿真/综合不匹配。这一新的硬件弱点涵盖与安全相关的场景：RTL 在综合后行为不同，可能泄露数据、改变受保护状态或绕过最终硬件中的安全控制。
警报与攻击事件

items: TianoCore 披露了其广泛使用的 EDK II UEFI 固件中的一个严重漏洞。该内存破坏缺陷可能允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者在 PXE 启动期间执行代码，此时操作系统尚未加载，且 Secure Boot 或 measured boot 尚无法验证任何操作系统组件。
Supermicro 在 10 月 26 日的两份公告中披露了九个 BMC 固件漏洞，其中包括一个严重缺陷，可能使未经身份验证的网络攻击者在活动会话中执行任意 IPMI 命令。这些披露还涉及权限提升、密钥泄露、内存访问和命令注入缺陷。
Keystone 称，一次数据泄露暴露了用于认证其硬件钱包的密钥，可能使假冒设备通过真伪检查。该公司正在销毁 18,835 台含有该受损密钥的未售出设备。

items: NIST 敲定了向 PQC 迁移的路线图，确定了联邦系统和技术提供商将需要用抗量子算法替换的易受量子攻击的标准。
NIST 还解释了其用于检测硬件篡改的射频指纹技术，利用设备无线电发射的细微差异来识别被改动或被替换的组件，在测试中准确率超过 95%。

Altera 推出了其 Agilex 2X FPGA 和 SoC 产品组合，具备硬件信任根、安全启动与认证、支持 PQC 的加密，以及面向以太网、PCIe 和内存的线速加密。

量子硬件
IBM 演示了连接两个 Nighthawk 量子处理器的四条互连，实现了 99% 的平均量子态转移保真度和 94.75% 的双量子比特门保真度，推进了模块化量子计算。

丹麦技术大学团队演示了使用二维材料的集成量子光源，将 WSe₂ 单光子发射器耦合到芯片上的 WS₂ 波导，估计最小波导耦合速率为每秒 168 万个光子。
